description: Vertical strip of a top-down pixel art fantasy world map: forested western foothills. Rounded green tree clusters in exactly the same greens as the reference canopy, a few grey rocky ridge lines between them, varied silhouettes, tapering to open grass near the bottom. No brown scree, no bare dirt slopes. No text, no borders.

reference_images.usage: east: the mountain and forest terrain immediately right of this strip; continue its canopy and colors westward
